description: This Java source file defines the 'AclEntryDeleted' event class, which represents an event emitted after a Thing ACL (Access Control List) entry has been deleted within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and methods for handling event metadata.
